Page 003

003-3. I'M_GOING TO THE BALCONY TO HAVE A LOOK.
003-4. U-UNCLE!
003-5. DON'TBE NERVOUS.
003-6. 紧张ing

003-8. THAT'S ONLY IF HE KNEW THE TRUTH.

Page 004
004-1. HAOZI!
004-2. WHO?!
004-3. NO ONE TO BE SEEN
004-4. UP HERE!!
004-5. HAOZI!

Page 005
005-1. HAVE AN APPLE!
005-2. FUCK OFF! YOU'RE MENT- ALLYILL! YOU'RE GIING MEAN APPLE THAT'S BIT?
005-3. WOULDN'T YOU GET IT,THIS APPLE.
005-4. DOYOU HAVE NOTHING BETTER TODO?
005-5. I AM PRETTY IDLE.
005-6. THEN WAIT A MOMENT!

Page 006
006-1. COME! QINGZI!
006-2. LET'S FIGHT TO THE DEATH!!
006-3. ..YOU..!
006-4. YOU'RE THE MENTALLYILL ONE!
006-5. ENOUGH NON- SENSE, WHERE'S YOURS?
006-6. I'M NOT ORESSING UP AND PLAYING AROUND WITH YOU!
006-7. HELP ME TAKE A PICTURE...
006-8. HAOZIIS REALLY ACTING LIKE AN IDIOT!

Page 007
007-1. SHIT! NOT RIGHT NOW! I'M NOT ORESSED RIGHT!
007-2. ALRIGHT,I'LL TAKE IT AGAIN. WHAT'S UNCLE HOLDING IN HIS HANDS?
007-3. A BELT.MY DAD SAID THAT IF YOU TIE SOMETHING THERE, IT WON'T PUT ALL THE PRESSURE ON THE SHOULDERS,ANDITLL LOOK BETTERTOO.
007-4. QIN'S PRODUCT
007-5. QING'S PRODUCT
007-6. QINGZI'SPIECE IS TOO SMALL, MINE IS WHAT REAL MEN WEAR! BOTH THE MATERIAL AND SIZE AREONE LEVEL HIGHER THAN XU QING'S PIECE!
007-7. GIRDLE YOUR WAISTSO THATYOU CAN BEAR THE WEIGHT, OTHERWISE IT WILL BECOME LOOSE AND YOUR SHOULDERS WILL TIRE OUT.
007-8. AS EXPECTED OF YOU! THERE'S ACTLALLY SUCH A THING.
007-9. ++ WHAT ARE THEY DOING?

Page 008
008-1. HAOZI WANTED ME TO TAKE A FULL BODY PICTURE OF HIM.
008-2. YOU TWO FINISHED TALKING?
008-3. WANT ONE?
008-4. YEAH, WE'RE DONE.

Page 009
009-1. IT'S SO AWESOME!
009-2. MY ASS!
009-3. YOU ONLY KNOW HOW TO PLAY EVERY DAY!
009-4. 咔嚓咔嚓咔嚓
009-5. DOES UNCLE QIN'S HAND NOT HURT DOING THAT?
009-6. IT LOOKS LIKE HAOZI IS FEELING IT, UNCLE QIN MUST BE USING A LOT OF FORCE.
009-7. WHAT DID HE ASK You?

Page 010
010-1. HE ASKED ME IF I REMEMBER WHICH PART OF ZHECHENG I WAS FROM AND WHERE MY HOME WAS.
010-2. IS UNCLE TRYING TO...
010-3. THAT'S RIGHT, HE'S GOING TO HELP US.
010-4. DON'T KEEP ON CALLING HIM UNCLE,
010-5. NEXT TIME,
010-6. KEEP CALLING HIM DAD.

Page 011
011-1. YOU'RE TEASING ME AGAIN!
011-2. AUNTIE SHOULD BE BACK AFTER SHOPPING FOR GROCERIES IN ABIT.IFTHERES A LOT TO CARRY, I'LL GO DOWNSTAIRS TO HELP PICKTHEM UP.

Page 012
012-1. LOOK AT HIM, AND THEN LOOK AT YOU!
012-2. DAD,I'M RIGHT HERE.
012-3. WAS I TALKING TO YOU?
012-4. TSK!
012-5. E 吓下 察
